about: Words that appear in model ids. They are data, not code: edit this file when a maker invents a new tier word. A tier word names the class of a model inside its line (it comes before or after the version number; no tier word means the line's standard model). An ignored word is neither the line nor the class (a stage, a price label, a style). A word in neither list that follows the version is a word this file does not know, so the class of that model is reported as unknown until the lead agent records it with `sisi workers fact WORKER --class NAME --source S`.
